title: chore: remove deprecated developers tag from pom
description:
Reverts the <developers> section added in #35.
Why
Per review feedback from @jonesbusy on #35: the <developers> tag in pom.xml has been deprecated for years. The source of truth for plugin maintainers/developers is the Repository Permission Updater (RPU), and this plugin is already correctly declared there:
# jenkins-infra/repository-permissions-updater/permissions/plugin-swarm-agents-cloud.yml
developers:
- "aronmav"
The plugin-modernizer-tool even ships an OpenRewrite recipe (RemoveDevelopersTag) that strips this tag, since it is redundant metadata that diverges from the RPU.
So the pom needs no <developers> section — removing it aligns the plugin with current Jenkins infrastructure standards.
